name: Morinaga Junta
source:
Main character.

He is an otaku who loves manga, anime, and video games. He spends his breaks either pretending to be asleep or playing social games.

He wants to be friends with people, but when he talks to them, he thinks too much about what he should do if he offends them or hurts them, so he can't speak well.

He has a strong sexual desire and masturbates at home. He has never had a girlfriend, but he has a strong desire to have sex with pretty girls.
